newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait share index down in busier trading week.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait share index down in busier trading week.

text.p: Kuwait Stock Exchange's (KSE) index fell 57.4 points to 2,361.6 during the week to Wednesday while trade volume and value rose compared to the previous week, figures released on Thursday show.

Daily average for value of traded shares rose to 18.96 million dinars ($62.37 million) from 15.65 million dinars. Trade volume edged up to a daily average of 54.1 million shares from 52.6 million, KSE figures show.
Gainers led losers 47-6, while 18 shares did not move.
Investment firms were the most active sector in terms of traded value with 29.6 million dinars, followed by industrials with 18.7 million and banks with 16.1 million.
Only nationals of Gulf Arab states -- Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, United Arab Emirates, Qatar, Oman and Kuwait -- can trade on the exchange. Foreign residents can invest in mutual funds.
